Indicator: Number of schools subsidised with learner transport
Outcome: Priority 1: A Capable, Ethical and Developmental State
Cluster: Governance, State Capacity and Institutional Development cluster
ReasonforDeviation_Summary: During the quarter under review 87 schools form B could not be submitted for validations due to kilometres discrepancies as per the SLA
CorrectiveAction_Summary: The Department has realised that reliance on scholar transport operators to submit Form B’s to support the performance on the number of schools receiving scholar transport service pose a challenge when some operators do not submit their claims on time as result affect the Department’s ability to provide the require portfolio on evidence on time. In this regard the Department will received the required Form B’s directly from the school on monthly basis.
ReasonforDeviation_Q1: During the quarter under  review 87 schools form B's could not be submitted for validations  due to kilometers discrepancies as per the SLA.
CorrectiveAction_Q1: The Department is currently conducting verification of the queried kilometers
ReasonforDeviation_Q2: Form Bs for 88 schools is a result of non submission of claims by appointed operators for those schools. appointed operators for those shools
CorrectiveAction_Q2: The Department has agreed with all operators that claims must be submitted on monthly basis within 7 days after month end or closing of schools. This will assist the monitoring of claims and form Bs.
ReasonforDeviation_Q3:
The submission of Form B’s is dependent 
on the operators submitting their claims on month basis. During the quarter under review 153 form B’s were submitted for validation due to the following reasons:

•	19 schools form B were submitted due replacement of operators due to non-compliance and poor service provision. 
•	29 schools were included on the benefiting schools by DOE but the schools are not provided with learner as yet.
•	105 due to non-submission of claims.
CorrectiveAction_Q3:
Request for approval for 
replacement operators in the 4th quarter.


Review the list of benefiting school in the 4th quarter to ensure that all benefiting schools are properly concluded.
The SLA to be reviewed in the next finalisation year to include punitive measures for non- submission of invoices on time. Furthermore, the means of verification will be reviewed to allow the Department to have control over the performance POE.
ReasonforDeviation_Q4: An underachievement of 72 is due to 19 schools awaiting approval in order for operators to claim, 29 schools are included in submission but not serviced and 24 not claims have not been submitted.
CorrectiveAction_Q4:
19 school’s submissions approved, addendums and appointment letters to be issued to affected operators,

29 schools will be replaced by schools that were not included on the approved list but were receiving learner transport service.

Operators reminded to submit Form B`s for 24 schools.

Moving forward, the department will collect Form B`s direct from the school through coordination of Department of Education.
